classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve UniProt-annotated sequences for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0097562) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0097531), run sequence-level biochemical analysis on both sets, gather literature context for NAD(P)HX repair proteins, and produce a unified ranked list of representative sequence candidates.
assumptions: GO:0097562 encodes ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity and GO:0097531 encodes NADPHX epimerase activity; both are established molecular-function GO terms in the NAD(P)HX repair pathway as annotated in the GOA/UniProt database.
Restricting to reviewed (Swiss-Prot) UniProt entries with exclude_iea=true maximises annotation confidence and minimises noise from computationally inferred annotations.
Up to 500 reviewed sequences per GO term are retrieved; these specialised repair enzymes have a limited annotation footprint so this cap is unlikely to be binding.
No taxon filter is applied; cross-kingdom diversity is retained to capture the full evolutionary range of NAD(P)HX repair proteins.
sequence_analysis is run on the full FASTA outputs from each go_sequences node; representative_sequences and metrics from each are forwarded to rank_designs.
rank_designs aggregates representative sequences and biochemical metrics from both activity classes to produce a unified ranked list limited to top 20 candidates.
literature_search provides mechanistic and biochemical context for NAD(P)HX repair but does not gate execution; its outputs inform interpretation of the ranked list.
Ranking is based solely on sequence-derived biochemical features (composition, charge, motifs, regions); no structure prediction is used.
pH 7.4 is used for charge and biochemical property calculations as a physiologically relevant default.

success_criteria.go_seqs_dehydratase: At least 1 reviewed sequence retrieved for GO:0097562 (ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity)
success_criteria.go_seqs_epimerase: At least 1 reviewed sequence retrieved for GO:0097531 (NADPHX epimerase activity)
success_criteria.seq_analysis_dehydratase: Biochemical metrics, motifs, and representative_sequences computed for the dehydratase FASTA
success_criteria.seq_analysis_epimerase: Biochemical metrics, motifs, and representative_sequences computed for the epimerase FASTA
success_criteria.lit_search: At least 5 publications with abstracts returned providing mechanistic context for NAD(P)HX repair dehydratase and epimerase activities
success_criteria.rank: Ranked list of up to 20 representative NAD(P)HX repair protein sequence candidates spanning both activity classes, returned as ranked_candidates with aggregated biochemical scores

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair ADP-dependent dehydratase epimerase protein enzyme
